channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Decreto de novo feriado nacional cai na sexta-feira e promove feriadão a milhões de trabalhadores em todo o Brasil
item.description: The National Day of Zumbi and Black Consciousness, observed on November 20, 2026, will fall on a Friday, creating a three-day weekend for workers who operate Monday through Friday. Established by decree, the measure is expected to benefit millions of Brazilians nationwide, offering a prolonged rest period in November.

item.title: Lula entra na campanha ao governo do DF e pressiona por desistência de candidato do PSB
item.description: Lula is pressuring the PSB to have Ricardo Cappelli withdraw his candidacy for governor of the Federal District and support Leandro Grass (PT), offering the vice-presidential spot on the PT ticket. Cappelli refused, stating he would not accept the vice position under any circumstances, though PSB leaders believe he might reconsider if Lula speaks to him directly. With the candidate registration deadline set for Saturday, the 15th, there is growing concern on the left that a split could prevent either candidate from advancing to the runoff against current governor Celina Leão (PP).

item.title: Guimarães diz que relação entre Lula e Alcolumbre está ‘destravada’ após nova reunião
item.description: Minister José Guimarães stated that the relationship between Lula and Davi Alcolumbre is 'unstuck' following a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, which also included Senate government leader Teresa Leitão. The meeting, not on the president’s official agenda, was described as a continuation of last week’s dinner at Justice Alexandre de Moraes’ residence and covered topics including the fuel bill, the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale, critical minerals regulation, and the PEC on Security.

item.title: Tereza Cristina se reúne com equipe de Flávio para avaliar participação na campanha
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) is meeting with Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign team to evaluate her role in the presidential campaign, after being ruled out as vice-presidential candidate due to the PP-União Brasil federation's neutrality. The meeting, including Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), will focus on the agribusiness section of the government plan, including the proposal to abolish the Ministry of Agrarian Development (MDA) and merge it with the Ministry of Agriculture. Cristina will decide whether to join campaign events and record videos with the candidate.

item.title: Rogério Lisboa, ex-vice de candidato bolsonarista, anuncia apoio a Eduardo Paes ao governo do RJ
item.description: Rogério Lisboa, former running mate of bolsonarist candidate Douglas Ruas, announced his support for Eduardo Paes in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race, citing the state's deep crisis and need for experienced leadership. Lisboa had been considered as Ruas’s vice-presidential pick but withdrew in July after the Progressistas party declared neutrality, allowing individual endorsements. He emphasized his decision was not a criticism of Ruas but a pragmatic response to Rio’s urgent challenges.

item.title: STF começa a julgar ação contra restrição de acesso a salários do Ministério Público
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) begins on Friday (14) the judgment of a Direct Action of Unconstitutionality challenging the restriction on access to salary information of the Public Prosecutor's Office. The action aims to ensure transparency in public spending, particularly regarding the remuneration of MP members, considered essential for social oversight and the fight against corruption.

item.title: Membros do PCO foram fornecedores do partido em 2024 e receberam R$ 2,69 milhões
item.description: The PCO used R$ 2.69 million from the electoral fund to hire services from its own party members during the 2024 municipal elections, according to the party's financial report submitted to the TSE. This practice raises concerns about the use of public funds to benefit internal party affiliates, though it does not necessarily imply illegality.

item.title: Campanhas com promessa de impeachment de ministros acirram tensão entre TSE e STF
item.description: 2026 election campaigns have included promises to impeach STF ministers, creating tension between the TSE and the STF. While the TSE views the debate as legitimate within freedom of expression, the STF sees such promises as an institutional attack. Candidates like Romeu Zema (Novo) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are leveraging the anti-STF agenda to mobilize support, particularly in the Senate, where Supreme Court appointments and impeachment proceedings are decided.

item.title: Lula melhora avaliação e permanece entre os cinco líderes mais populares
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva maintained fifth place in the CB Global Data Latin American leaders popularity ranking in August 2026, with 51.9% positive and 46.1% negative image, showing a slight improvement from July (50.6% positive, 47.1% negative). The ranking is led by Nayib Bukele of El Salvador with 68.7% approval, followed by Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico and Keiko Fujimori of Peru.

item.title: Lula recebe Alcolumbre no Alvorada para tentar destravar pautas no Senado; ministro fala em 'institucionalidade reconstruída'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) at the Palácio da Alvorada to advance key government agendas in Congress, including the public security PEC and the end of the 6x1 work scale. Minister José Guimarães stated that institutionality has been restored and described the meeting as productive and relaxed. This marks the second meeting between Lula and Alcolumbre as part of a political rapprochement following a period of strained relations.

item.title: Alvo da PF, Lulinha muda endereço de sua empresa na Espanha
item.description: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) moved the registered address of his Spanish IT consultancy to a prestigious location on Paseo de la Castellana in Madrid in April, with the update only formalized last week. The move comes as he faces a Federal Police investigation into suspected influence peddling and passive corruption linked to the Ministry of Health, involving lobbyist 'Careca do INSS'. His defense claims he is being persecuted due to his relationship with President Lula.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre se reúnem para discutir agenda de interesse do Planalto no Congresso: 'Diálogo foi retomado', diz ministro
item.description: Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre met to restore dialogue and advance the government's agenda in Congress, focusing on issues such as the 6x1 workweek PEC, the Public Security PEC, the rare earths project, the MP ending the 'blusinhas tax,' and the bill criminalizing misogynistic acts. Minister José Guimarães said institutional relations have been rebuilt and further meetings are planned by week's end.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Campanhas eleitorais ‘anti-STF’ devem acirrar tensão entre ministros
item.description: Electoral campaigns criticizing the Supreme Federal Court (STF) and promising ministerial impeachment are expected to heighten tensions between the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and the STF. The TSE views impeachment discussion as legitimate campaign speech if it does not incite violence, while the STF fears such rhetoric constitutes institutional attack and may respond via disinformation investigations or other mechanisms.

item.title: Ibovespa opera entre perdas e ganhos com inflação dos EUA e temporada de balanços
item.description: The Ibovespa is trading between gains and losses on Wednesday, influenced by U.S. inflation data in line with expectations and mixed corporate earnings results. Despite some companies reporting better-than-expected profits, such as B3, Cury and Direcional, their stocks showed volatility, reflecting foreign investors' risk aversion due to Brazil's electoral and fiscal uncertainties, alongside the appeal of fixed income with the Selic rate at 14%. The dollar rose 0.26% while the Ibovespa declined 0.08% to 167,733.48 points.

item.title: Direção nacional da federação PSOL-Rede anula decisão mineira e define apoio ao PT no estado
item.description: The national executive of the Rede-PSOL Federation annulled Minas Gerais' decision to support Alexandre Kalil (PDT) and declared full backing for Patrus Ananias (PT) as gubernatorial candidate, aligning with Lula's ticket. The PT-led slate also includes Marília Campos (PT) and Áurea Carolina (PSOL) as Senate candidates, with the PT securing Áurea's nomination despite Kalil's initial opposition. The alliance in Minas Gerais, the country's second-largest electoral college, was finalized after months of uncertainty, reinforcing the federation's support for Lula's re-election.

item.title: Líder do PT sofre AVC durante reunião na Câmara, é internado e tem ‘evolução clínica positiva’
item.description: Federal Deputy Pedro Uczai (PT-SC), leader of the PT in the Chamber of Deputies, suffered an ischemic stroke during a Leaders' College meeting on Tuesday, was hospitalized in Brasília and remains in the ICU for observation, with positive clinical evolution and no cognitive or motor impairments. The incident led to the cancellation of Tuesday night's plenary session, impacting the Congressional agenda during the concentrated work week.

item.title: Chefe da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, Marinho pede a Fachin que STF julgue ações sobre a Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, chief of Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential campaign, urged STF President Edson Fachin to rule on four actions challenging the constitutionality of the Dosimetry Law, approved in 2025, which allows sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. The law was suspended by Minister Alexandre de Moraes and remains pending before the STF, despite a favorable opinion from the PGR. Marinho stated the actions are ready for judgment and emphasized the case's relevance to principles of individualized and proportional punishment.

item.title: Equipe de Lula vê plano de Marco Rubio para impedir reeleição após vídeo dos EUA sobre domínio nas Américas
item.description: Lula’s team believes U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is pursuing a strategy to prevent Lula’s re-election in 2026 by expanding American influence across Latin America through a 'backyard diplomacy' approach, with Brazil as the primary target. This conviction is based on a State Department video reviving the Monroe Doctrine and highlighting U.S. interventions, such as actions against Nicolás Maduro, as demonstrations of regional dominance. Lula’s advisors liken Rubio’s ideological faction to 'Penguins of Madagascar piloting Air Force One', implying clumsy execution despite ambitious goals.

item.title: Lançamento de campanha de Lula terá discurso de mulheres após constrangimento em convenção do PT
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign launch will feature speeches by women following embarrassment at the PT convention over the absence of female voices. The event will take place at Vila Euclides Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo, recreating the 1979 imagery of Lula speaking from a makeshift table, with caravans from Rio, Curitiba, and Minas Gerais. Lula will deliver a concise speech focusing on his political trajectory, national sovereignty, ending the 6x1 work schedule, and combating violence against women.

item.title: Flávio tenta ampliar presença de Michelle na campanha após reencontro, mas participação deve seguir pontual
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sought to increase Michelle Bolsonaro's presence in his presidential campaign following their Tuesday reunion, but her participation is expected to remain limited and intermediate. Michelle demonstrated public unity but avoided committing to an intensive schedule, citing her duties caring for Jair Bolsonaro and emphasizing her role via social media and women's mobilization. The campaign hopes for another joint event, but allies anticipate continued spaced appearances.

item.title: Candidato de Flávio ao governo de MG anuncia aliada de Michelle como vice, e Cleitinho posta 'boa sorte'
item.description: Businessman Flávio Roscoe (PL) announced councilwoman Ellen Miziara (PL) as his running mate for governor of Minas Gerais, praising her leadership in PL Women and her commitment to family, work, and entrepreneurship. The announcement was welcomed by PL allies, including Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicans), who, despite being Roscoe’s electoral rival, wished her 'good luck'. Despite running separately in the first round, Roscoe and Bolsonaro agreed to support whichever candidate advances to a potential runoff.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro comemora fala de Michelle ao declarar que crise é 'página virada'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign celebrated Michelle Bolsonaro's statement that their family conflict is a "page turned," saying she has put a "stone" on the issue and emphasizing unity to defeat Lula. Although reconciled, Michelle will not play an active role in the presidential campaign's daily operations, focusing instead on her Senate bid and caring for Jair Bolsonaro. Her recorded message will be used in the campaign's initial materials.

item.title: Michelle garante apoio a Flávio, mas trégua expõe conveniência
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro recorded campaign support for Flávio Bolsonaro despite months of family conflicts, aiming to engage conservative female voters. Her appearance was brief and pragmatic, avoiding questions about Jair Bolsonaro’s other children, with the goal of shielding the conservative electorate. For Flávio, the endorsement is vital to reduce his rejection and bolster an isolated presidential bid.

item.title: Haddad acusa Tarcísio de “mentir” sobre suposto elo com tráfico
item.description: Fernando Haddad accused Governor Tarcísio de Freitas of lying for claiming Haddad shared a stage with a drug trafficking leader during a Sunday debate, stating he could not locate the referenced photo and suggesting the governor received the information from someone else. Haddad also criticized Tarcísio’s public security management, alleging inaction despite police presence at the event, and reiterated his proposal to create a state anti-faction agency within the Palácio dos Bandeirantes, involving federal agencies and police. He further advocated for WhatsApp-based police reports aided by AI to map crime hotspots in real time.

item.title: Homem que depôs sobre armação contra vice de Flávio pediu dinheiro para denunciar petista
item.description: Luiz Antonio Lopes, a 63-year-old merchant, testified before the STF accusing PT deputy Lindbergh Farias of leading a plot to damage the reputation of Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro’s vice-presidential candidate, through false rape allegations. After reaffirming his claims to Radar, Lopes demanded payment to reveal alleged evidence, citing a supposed TV network deal, prompting the outlet to end the conversation. He has since provided contradictory versions of the story, including the whereabouts of the alleged accuser, and is affiliated with Gaspar’s PL party.

item.title: Vídeo: Sargento Reginauro, suplente de Girão, toma posse no Senado
item.description: Sargent Reginauro (PSDB-CE) was sworn in as senator for Ceará on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, filling the vacancy left by licensed Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE). He is Girão’s first alternate and now represents the state in the Federal Senate. The inauguration took place during an ordinary deliberative session of the Senate.

item.title: O Ibovespa, a volatilidade eleitoral e o cenário externo
item.description: The Ibovespa and EWZ are recovering after a drop driven by electoral volatility in Brazil, though external uncertainty — particularly in the U.S. and the Middle East — continues to limit relief. U.S. CPI inflation rose 0.1% in July, reversing June’s decline, with persistent pressure due to falling Middle Eastern oil exports and an expected deficit of 1.8 million barrels/day in Q3. These external factors may make any inflation relief temporary, increasing imported volatility for Brazilian markets.

item.title: Conteúdos políticos de IA viralizam antes do início oficial da campanha. Má notícia para o eleitor: ferramentas de detecção falham
item.description: A study by the Lupa Observatory, in partnership with Faap, identified over 40 AI-generated political contents that went viral in Brazil between February and June 2024, before the official campaign began. These include deepfakes requesting votes, satirical portrayals of politicians, and avatars spreading false polls, underscoring the failure of detection tools to identify such manipulations.

item.title: Plano de governo de Tarcísio prevê construção de 20 hospitais
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' 2026 re-election government plan proposes building 20 new hospitals in São Paulo by 2026, including facilities in São Vicente, Guarujá, Mirante do Paranapanema, Itapetininga, Birigui, and Campinas. The plan emphasizes AI use in healthcare, particularly telemedicine, and in education to improve student attention, despite past controversy over shifting to 100% digital textbooks. No total investment figure is yet finalized, though R$ 2.1 billion was invested between 2023 and 2026 in 14 hospitals and 8,800 new beds.

item.title: Eleitores veem medo e fraqueza em candidatos que fogem de debate
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are avoiding debates in the first round of the 2026 elections, creating perceptions of fear and weakness among voters. Although they concentrate 70% of voting intentions among decided voters, their absence leaves a negative impression: six in ten voters distrust those who dodge debates, interpreting it as unpreparedness or fear of divergent opinions. Despite their apparent electoral strength, both have been rejected by half the electorate for over seven months, according to polls.

item.title: Tarcísio não mencionou o nome do Flávio Bolsonaro uma única vez no debate da Band, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) stated that Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) avoided mentioning Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) name during the Band TV debate, suggesting a strategy to distance himself from the Bolsonaro presidential candidate. Haddad claimed the absence of any reference to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the Sunday, 9 debate indicates an effort by the governor to dissociate from the Bolsonaro family's alliance in the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: MG: após racha, PSol consegue reverter apoio a Kalil e fecha com Patrus
item.description: The National Executive of the Rede-PSol Federation overturned Minas Gerais' decision to support Alexandre Kalil (PDT) and confirmed backing for Patrus Ananias (PT) in the state gubernatorial race. The reversal followed a veto request from the Minas PSol, which opposed the PDT alliance and the PSDB's presence on Kalil's ticket. The PSol now formally joins Patrus's ticket alongside Lula, Áurea Carolina (PSol) and Marília Campos (PT), while the Rede retains local freedom to support Kalil.

item.title: A leitura de Tereza Cristina sobre corrida ao comando do Senado após ser cotada para vice de Flávio
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina (PL-MS) joked about being considered as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket, stating that her ambitions to lead the Senate from 2027 onward would not be hindered by potential resistance from Lula’s base. She argued that the Senate’s composition after 2025 would not be left-leaning, downplaying the political consequences of her near-candidacy. Despite pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro and PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto, she declined the vice-presidential offer due to the party’s neutrality in the presidential race.

item.title: Aproximação de Motta com Lula afasta PL do presidente da Câmara
item.description: The growing alignment between Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) and Lula is causing pushback from the PL, which views the rapprochement as a barrier to future alliance with Motta in his 2027 bid for re-election as chamber leader. PL leaders say Motta’s public support for Lula’s re-election complicates any dialogue with Bolsonaro’s party, especially if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 presidential election, potentially prompting the PL to field its own candidate — such as current PL leader in the Chamber, Sóstenes Cavalcante (RJ).

item.title: Governo libera R$ 884 mi em emendas de parlamentares que livraram Lulinha na CPMI
item.description: The Lula government allocated R$ 884.37 million in parliamentary amendments to the 19 congressmen who voted against the CPMI-INSS report on March 28, shielding deputy Lulinha. This amount represents 98.64% of all amendments committed by the government, suggesting extensive use of public funds to reward legislators aligned with the Executive.

item.title: Congresso instala comissão que analisa MP que acaba com taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Congress has installed a mixed committee to analyze the provisional measure that repeals the 20% import tax on international purchases under $50, known as the 'blusinhas tax'. The MP, issued by Lula in May, expires on September 24; if not voted on, the tax will automatically resume, potentially affecting voter sentiment ahead of the 2026 elections. The committee's installation is seen as a gesture of reconciliation between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula after months of political strain.

item.title: Guerras e eleição no Brasil elevam cautela para investimentos em infraestrutura; país precisa de mais de R$ 500 bilhões anuais para o setor
item.description: The Ferrogrão railway project, spanning 933 km with an expected investment of R$ 8.4 billion, is seen as a key asset awaited by investors for transporting agricultural output from Mato Grosso, including soy, corn, fertilizer, sugar, ethanol, and petroleum derivatives. Brazil’s need for over R$ 500 billion annually in infrastructure investment heightens investor caution amid global conflicts and the 2026 electoral cycle. The Ministry of Infrastructure emphasizes the project’s strategic role in national logistics development.

item.title: O cálculo de Flávio Bolsonaro para passar Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign is crafting a strategy to win the 2026 presidential runoff, based on three pillars: boosting votes in key states, uniting right-wing forces, and leveraging anti-PT sentiment. The calculation aims to consolidate broad support among conservative and dissatisfied voters to overturn a potential deficit against Lula in the second round.

item.title: O terraplanismo fiscal de Lula e a herança maldita para 2027
item.description: The article discusses Brazil's concerning fiscal situation, attributing it to the alleged unfounded spending of the current Lula government, and mentions a growing debate about how the president will handle the 'poisoned inheritance' he will leave for himself if re-elected in 2026, affecting the challenges of 2027.

item.title: TSE deve multar Flávio por IA e alinhar julgamento sobre pesquisa suspensa
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques has convened a meeting to address two critical agenda items: the use of Jair Bolsonaro's avatar in Flávio Bolsonaro's convention and the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll during the 'Dark Horse' crisis. Both issues involve potential electoral law violations and may lead to fines or binding rulings.

item.title: STF não vai acelerar nem travar apuração de queixa contra vice de Flávio
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) decided neither to accelerate nor to stall the investigation of the rape of a vulnerable person complaint against Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate (PL). The accusation, under investigation by the Federal Police, involves a serious case that has sparked intense political repercussions. The STF maintained the ordinary procedural process, avoiding extraordinary interventions in the case.

item.title: Haddad convoca Bolsonaro ao debate e dá combustível a Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad invited Jair Bolsonaro to participate in a debate, increasing the political visibility of the event and generating impact on the electoral campaign. The move was interpreted as an attempt to force Bolsonaro to take a public stance, while also indirectly benefiting Tarcísio de Freitas, who gained space in the debate without facing the former president directly. The action reinforced the polarization dynamic in the 2026 elections, particularly in the context of São Paulo state.

item.title: Crise entre Mendonça e PF: Silêncio de entidades e desconfiança política acentuam tensão
item.description: Tension between the STF and the PF continues a week after a meeting between the Justice Minister and André Mendonça, with the silence of PF class entities reflecting internal distrust. Although no arbitrary acts by Mendonça affecting investigative independence have been identified, discomfort with PF Director-General Andrei Rodrigues — due to his close ties to Lula — and actions such as attempting to redistribute inquiries on 'Lulinha' and changing the investigative team are deepening the crisis. The AGU has warned against obstruction, while Mendonça faces criticism for attitudes generating discontent within the forces.

item.title: A resposta de Alcolumbre ao apelo de petistas para votar o fim da escala 6 por 1
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) was urged by Lula government leaders to schedule a vote on ending the 6x1 work scale, a key campaign promise for the president’s re-election bid. While seeking rapprochement with the Planalto Palace, Alcolumbre heard the appeal from petista leaders, though the article — available only to subscribers — does not reveal his final stance. The issue is tied to labor reform and political coordination between the Executive and Legislative branches ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: É #FAKE que eleições de 2026 terão novo modelo de urna eletrônica
item.description: The TSE denies that new electronic voting machines will be adopted for the 2026 elections, stating that the models currently in use — UE2022, UE2020, UE2015, and UE2013 — will continue to be deployed, with identical technical functionality despite design differences. The development of the next-generation UE2028 model is underway via public consultation and will be used starting in the 2028 municipal elections. The false claim spread on social media, alleging new machines, source-code audits, and international presence, was debunked by the TSE.

item.title: Tabata Amaral declara ter ficado R$ 133 mil mais pobre em dois anos
item.description: Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP) declared a loss of R$ 133,000 in her net worth between 2024 and 2026, dropping from R$ 807,800 to R$ 674,500, according to her TSE filing. Her current assets include investments (R$ 588,500), a checking account (R$ 6,300), and a financed property (R$ 79,500). In 2018, her wealth was R$ 122,900, indicating prior growth followed by a recent decline.

item.title: Michelle ganha espaço e campanha de Flávio quer usá-la como trunfo
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro is gaining prominence in the presidential campaign of her stepson, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), after weeks of public disagreements. Flávio’s team plans for her to appear alongside him in three campaign events and to act as a digital campaign asset through social media videos and posts, aiming to mobilize female leaders within the PL and conservative movement. Flávio stated that Michelle would have 'direct access to the Presidency' to advocate for Distrito Federal demands if both are elected.

item.title: A 53 dias das eleições, candidatos da 3ª via patinam nas pesquisas
item.description: With 53 days until the election, third-way candidates Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Romeu Zema (Novo), and Renan Santos (Missão) remain below 5% in national polls, unable to break the polarization between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Despite minor fluctuations within the margin of error, none exceed 5% individually, while Lula and Flávio maintain leads above 30 points. In hypothetical second-round matchups against Lula, Caiado reaches 42% (technical tie), but this does not translate into viability for advancing to the second round in the first vote.

item.title: Filho de Tarcísio blinda Lulinha de debate e é apelidado por Haddad
item.description: The establishment of a company by Tarcísio de Freitas' sons, using the Palácio dos Bandeirantes as their address, raised suspicions that firms benefiting from São Paulo's tax incentives are clients of the new entity, suggesting potential conflicts of interest. Despite these allegations, Fernando Haddad chose not to raise the issue in the first debate against Tarcísio, instead focusing on his ties to Jair Bolsonaro and Eduardo Bolsonaro. Prior to the debate, Haddad reportedly remarked that if the involved party were 'Lulinha' (Lula's son) rather than 'Tarcizinho' (Tarcísio's son), the backlash would have been far stronger.

item.title: Campanha quer Lula com discurso direto, combativo e menos improvisos
item.description: Lula's campaign is pushing for a more direct, combative, and less improvised speech after criticism of his scattered remarks at the PT's August convention. The strategy aims to avoid centering his narrative on his personal trajectory and instead focus on direct comparisons with Bolsonaro's government. The official campaign launch will take place in São Bernardo do Campo, Lula's political birthplace, on Sunday, August 16.
